messages.subject: Brookmere master subscription agreement - one more point
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Quick one on the Brookmere MSA, not Skylark - their procurement want the uptime SLA bumped to 99.9% before they'll sign. Can we hold at 99.5% or should we give it? Happy to jump on a call.

Maya Patel
CFO, Caspian Technologies
